Looking at performance - making 3 cleaned datasets, bilingual, monolingual, and all

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

install.packages("usethis")
library(usethis)

create_github_token()

install.packages("gitcreds")
library(gitcreds)

gitcreds_set()

#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

library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

LENA <- read.csv("lena.csv")

LENA <- LENA %>%
  rename(
    Noise = noise_sum,
    ID = Participant
  )

LENA <- LENA[, c("ID", "Noise")]

LENA <- LENA %>%
  mutate(
    base_id = sub("_V2$", "", ID)
  ) %>%
  group_by(base_id) %>%
  filter(
    !(!grepl("_V2$", ID) & any(grepl("_V2$", ID)))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-base_id)

LENA <- LENA %>%
  mutate(ID = sub("_V2$", "", ID))

HABIT <- read.csv("hab.csv")

#I used Nov1 I think this is what we did before

HABIT <- HABIT %>%
  rename(
    Novelty = nov_score,
    ID = Participant
  )

HABIT <- HABIT[, c("ID", "Novelty")]

HABIT <- HABIT %>%
  mutate(
    base_id = sub("_V2$", "", ID)
  ) %>%
  group_by(base_id) %>%
  filter(
    !(!grepl("_V2$", ID) & any(grepl("_V2$", ID)))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-base_id)

HABIT <- HABIT %>%
  mutate(ID = sub("_V2$", "", ID))

MCDI <- read.csv("mcdi.csv")

MCDI <- MCDI %>%
  rename(
    MCDI = mcdi,
    ID = Participant
  )

MCDI <- MCDI %>%
  mutate(
    base_id = sub("_V2$", "", ID)
  ) %>%
  group_by(base_id) %>%
  filter(
    !(!grepl("_V2$", ID) & any(grepl("_V2$", ID)))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-base_id)

MCDI <- MCDI %>%
  mutate(ID = sub("_V2$", "", ID))

#Now the eye-gaze

bilingual <- read.csv("bwindow.csv", na.strings = c("", "NA"))

bilingual <- bilingual[!grepl("baseline_[0-9]+", bilingual$Trial.Type), ]

bilingual$Condition <- ifelse(
  grepl("quiet", bilingual$Trial.Type, ignore.case = TRUE),
  "quiet",
  ifelse(
    grepl("noise", bilingual$Trial.Type, ignore.case = TRUE),
    "noise",
    NA
  )
)

bilingual <- bilingual %>%
  mutate(
    Trial.Type = sub("^(quiet_|noise_)", "", Trial.Type)
  )

bilingual <- bilingual %>%
  rename(
    Target = Trial.Type,
    Accuracy = Trial.Accuracy,
    ID = Participant
  )

bilingual <- bilingual %>%
  select(-Trial.Number, -Frames.to.Target, -Frames.to.Distractor, -X)

bilingual <- bilingual %>%
  filter(!is.na(ID))

bilingual <- bilingual %>%
  filter(!is.na(Accuracy))

bilingual  <- left_join(
 bilingual,
  LENA,
  by = "ID"
)

bilingual  <- left_join(
 bilingual,
  HABIT,
  by = "ID"
)

bilingual  <- left_join(
 bilingual,
  MCDI,
  by = "ID"
)

bilingual$Language <- "Bilingual"

#Cleaning Monolingual

monolingual <- read.csv("mwindow.csv")

monolingual <- monolingual[!grepl("baseline_[0-9]+", monolingual$Trial.Type), ]

monolingual$Condition <- ifelse(
  grepl("quiet", monolingual$Trial.Type, ignore.case = TRUE),
  "quiet",
  ifelse(
    grepl("noise", monolingual$Trial.Type, ignore.case = TRUE),
    "noise",
    NA
  )
)

monolingual <- monolingual %>%
  mutate(
    Trial.Type = sub("^(quiet_|noise_)", "", Trial.Type)
  )

monolingual <- monolingual %>%
  rename(
    Target = Trial.Type,
    Accuracy = Trial.Accuracy,
    ID = Participant
  )

monolingual <- monolingual %>%
  select(-Trial.Number, -Frames.to.Target, -Frames.to.Distractor, -X)

monolingual <- monolingual %>%
  filter(!is.na(ID))

monolingual <- monolingual %>%
  filter(!is.na(Accuracy))

monolingual$Language <- "Monolingual"

monolingual  <- left_join(
 monolingual,
  LENA,
  by = "ID"
)

monolingual  <- left_join(
 monolingual,
  HABIT,
  by = "ID"
)

monolingual  <- left_join(
 monolingual,
  MCDI,
  by = "ID"
)

all <- rbind(bilingual, monolingual)

```

Bilingual analysis

```{r cars}

biling_acc <- bilingual %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_accuracy = mean(Accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(biling_acc)

#avg for both is .52
#not running on that

b_noise <- lmer(Novelty ~ Noise + (1|ID),
                data = bilingual, REML = FALSE)
#errored out

summary(b_noise)
VarCorr(b_noise)
#highly correlated
isSingular(b_noise)
#not singular

lm_biling <- lm(Novelty ~ Noise, data = bilingual)

summary(lm_biling)

#nothing - ran it with nov1 and nov_score from original document

lm_biling_mcdi <- lm(MCDI ~ Noise, data = bilingual)

summary(lm_biling_mcdi)

#nope

```

## Comparisons

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}

monovbiling <- lmer(Accuracy ~ Condition * Language + (1|ID),
                data = all, REML = FALSE)

summary(monovbiling)

#if i add anything else it is singular

```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
